shareCta.title: Share Your Story
shareCta.description: Has GetCyberRight helped you or your family? We'd love to hear from you. Your story could inspire others to protect their loved ones.

grace.quote: After my mother almost lost her savings to a mobile money scam, GetCyberRight's Senior Protection guide helped our whole family understand the warning signs. She now confidently uses her phone without fear.

david.quote: My teenage son was being cyberbullied on a gaming platform. The Youth Safety resources gave us the words to have a real conversation and steps to protect his accounts. He's much happier now.

margaret.quote: I received a suspicious WhatsApp message claiming to be from my bank. Thanks to the scam checker tool, I verified it was fraud before clicking any links. You saved me from losing everything.

samuel.quote: As a teacher, I use the printable guides in my classroom. Students now understand why they shouldn't share passwords or personal photos online. This should be taught in every school.

faith.quote: My elderly father fell for a SIM swap scam. After using the Emergency Help page, we reported it within hours and recovered 60% of the stolen funds. Your step-by-step guide was a lifesaver.

james.quote: I'm a community worker and I share GetCyberRight resources during outreach visits. Families trust the simple language and practical advice. It's making a real difference in our community.
